text:
anya: quick question — in the /v1/usage endpoint, are `cached_tokens` supposed to be included in `billable_tokens` or reported separately for reconciliation?

mike: they should be reported separately. `billable_tokens` should represent what we actually charge (post-cache). `cached_tokens` is diagnostic.

ajosephine: tagging @mike — accounting here. we need a single canonical way to reconstruct invoiceable units from the API response. if clients get `cached_tokens + prompt_tokens + completion_tokens` they could accidentally double-count. proposal: keep `billable_tokens` as the single source of truth for billing and mark `cached_origin`/`cache_hit` for debugging.

akshay: fwiw, streaming responses complicate this. current streaming events return partial `delta_tokens`. do we intend to emit `cache_hit` in the initial response headers or as the final event?

mike: good point. implementation plan i sketched in the PR: for streaming we set `cache_hit: true` in the initial 200/headers when the runtime returns a cache hit for a prefix (so client can short-circuit UI). final event (done) includes the full `billable_tokens` and `cached_tokens` numbers.

anya: can we get the exact example payload to lock the contract? something small we can paste in SDK tests.

mike: sure — suggested stable shape (v1.2):
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "prompt_tokens": 42,
  "completion_tokens": 0,
  "cached_tokens": 42,
  "billable_tokens": 0,
  "cache_hit": true,
  "cache_origin": "kv-prefix-v1"
}
```
Note: `billable_tokens` is an integer >= 0. When `cache_hit` is true `billable_tokens` may be 0.

josephine: this looks fine. two asks: 1) add `billing_basis` string to clarify if this is "per-token" or "min-bundle" for reconciliations, 2) make sure empty fields are explicit (e.g., `cache_origin: null` when not hit) so downstream ETL doesn't break.

akshay: also add a short note in the API docs about racey rehydration: when a request rehydrates a cache entry we should surface `rehydrated: true` and show `rehydrated_tokens` so accounting can attribute the rehydration cost to the triggering request.

mike: ok i'll update the PR with `billing_basis`, `rehydrated` and `rehydrated_tokens`. will keep `billable_tokens` authoritative.

anya: thanks — can someone please ping me on the CR when it's ready? i have a small frontend change to gate the blue "cached" badge. :pray:

mike: will do. putting review ping now. @anya @josephine @akshay — CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/452 (diff includes tests for streaming + non-streaming shapes) :eyes:

josephine: doing accounting recon tests tomorrow morning. if we find discrepancies we'll open a separate ticket.

billing-bot: automated note — when `billable_tokens` is 0 and `cached_tokens` > 0, events will be routed to `billing.debug` for 30d retention.

anya: perfect — thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for the decision. we can follow up in product sync if needed. :thumbsup:
